create_solvent_from_atoms: create a Solvent object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing a solvent molecule
create_solvent_from_db: create a Solvent object by passing a solvent ID index to load from the solvent database
create_solvent_with_density: create a Solvent object with a custom solvent density override value
get_molecules_per_volume: get the number of molecules per angstrom cubed from a Solvent object using the molecules_per_volume property
get_solvent_molar_mass: get the molar mass of a Solvent object by summing atomic masses from the atoms attribute
